reason: A conversational database analysis plugin that inspects schemas, generates and executes SQL, presents business insights, and produces optional HTML visual reports through Web UI and terminal workflows.

summaries.zh: 通过对话连接多种数据库，自动探查表结构、生成并执行SQL、分析结果并生成可选的HTML数据报告。
summaries.en: Connects to supported databases through conversation, explores schemas, generates and executes SQL, analyzes results, and optionally produces HTML data reports.

capabilities: Inspects schemas and executes SQL queries
Can execute update or management statements when permitted by configuration and credentials
Generates offline HTML analysis reports and saves them to the working directory
Invokes local database command-line clients and an HTTP database adapter
